headline: Answering questions about voting from poll opening to poll closing on General Election Day.
summary: Residents may ask questions about voting. The session runs from when polls open until they close on General Election Day.
items: Answer questions about voting from the time polls open on General Election Day until they close
location: Town Hall Council Chambers, 180 High Street, Wakefield RI 02879
plain_text:
Posted on 10/22/2026 
 
Town of South Kingstown  
Canvassing Authority  
Regular Session Meeting Agenda   
Tuesday, November 3, 2026 at 7:00 AM   
Town Hall Council Chambers 
180 High Street 
Wakefield RI 02879 
www.southkingstownri.gov  
Walter A. Young, Jr., Chair 
Sarah L. Vaccaro, Vice Chair 
Elaine D. Shanley, Member 
  
1. New Business: 
 A. The Canvassing Authority will be in session from the time the polls open on General Election Day until the 
closure of the polls to answer any questions relative to voting. 
  
 
NOTE: Individuals requesting American Sign Language interpreters or CART service must call the Town Clerk’s Office at 
401-789-9331 seventy-two (72) hours in advance of the meeting date. 
 
YouTube link: https://youtube.com/@skmiscboards/streams
